Container.Name: pinkcollab-omp
Container.Overview: Oh My Pi + PinkCollab Gateway for Android, updated via your own GitHub Container Registry image. Requires a trusted HTTPS reverse proxy for Android.
Container.Description: Community integration image of original upstream releases. One container runs OMP and PinkCollab Gateway. The gateway port is unencrypted and intended only for a local HTTPS reverse proxy, never direct Internet exposure.

Config.Name: HTTP upstream (HTTPS proxy only)
Config.Description: Do not expose this plain-HTTP gateway port to the Internet

Config.Description: Persistent model auth, settings and conversations

Config.Name: PinkCollab pairing and settings
Config.Description: Persistent gateway config and paired client secrets

Config.Name: Persistent user-installed tools
Config.Description: Programs installed by agent with npm global prefix or in .local/bin survive updates

Config.Name: SSH keys and hosts
Config.Description: Persistent SSH client keys and known_hosts; keep this folder private
